title: Northbridge University
useCase: Slack for Education, backed by Education Cloud. Student services, a lecturer, and two students work Jordan Hale's offer and Jamie's first weeks. Only Alex has a Salesforce licence.
beats: Jordan Hale HIST is the record channel for Jordan's History application. The record sits at the top. Sam's fee plan message and Riley's Harbour Hall message each have a staff thread. The Education Cloud alert is added by the presenter and is not posted as a person.
Slackbot answers the accommodation deposit deadline from the Staff handbook, and cites Fees, Winter 2026.
Slackbot builds a view of History offer holders with no contact in 14 days and what is still outstanding. Jordan is one of four.

Slackbot drafts Alex's direct message to Jordan, including the Welcome checklist. Alex edits a word and sends it. Slackbot then logs the contact and a Thursday follow-up, after Alex approves the preview.

Casey has no Salesforce licence. Slackbot catches Casey up on the History channels. In #history-staff, Alex tells Casey that Jamie missed 2 HIS201 seminars, and the rest of that conversation is in the thread.
Casey messages Jamie about 15 minutes after Thursday's seminar, then shows the week 7 reading pinned in #his201-seminar-b.
Jordan ticks the first two items on the Welcome checklist, meets Jamie in #history-offer-holders, and asks Slackbot about the deposit. The answer comes from the Student FAQ.
Jamie's sidebar is Course, Campus, and Societies. Slackbot offers the Student help request for a broken laptop and an essay due Friday.
Alex claims the request in #student-help-triage, approves a case for the laptop and the HIS201 extension, and resolves it.
Trust and safety is talk track: separate workspaces, content filtering, Slackbot permissions, retention, and Slack alongside Microsoft.

slack.story:
Northbridge University
Slack for Education, backed by Education Cloud.
One workspace. Separate staff and student workspaces are talk track.
1. Jordan Hale HIST is the record channel. Alex, Sam, and Riley. Jordan is not in it.
2. Slackbot answers the deposit policy, then builds the quiet History offer holder view.
3. Alex nudges Jordan with the welcome checklist, then logs the contact.
4. Casey catches up, reads the #history-staff thread about Jamie missing 2 seminars, and messages Jamie.
5. Jordan ticks the checklist and meets Jamie in #history-offer-holders.
6. Jamie raises a Student help request. Alex turns it into a case.
7. Close on trust and safety.
Tag: [demo-builder:edu-ido]

manualSteps.title: Group Jamie's sidebar
manualSteps.detail: In Jamie's Slack client, make three sections: Course (#his201-seminar-b and #history-offer-holders), Campus (#campus), Societies (#film-society). The API cannot set sidebar sections.

manualSteps.title: Build the Student help request
manualSteps.detail: In Workflow Builder, create a shortcut named Student help request. Fields: What do you need? (checkboxes: Laptop or IT, Coursework extension, Fees or funding, Accommodation, Wellbeing, Something else), Course (dropdown: HIS201, Not a specific course), Needed by (date), What happened (rich text). Post the answers to #student-help-triage with Claim and Resolve. Resolve asks for one rich-text Note. Leave the channel empty until the live submit. Jamie ticks Laptop or IT and Coursework extension, chooses HIS201, sets Friday 4 December 2026, and says the laptop will not open files and the essay needs an extension.

manualSteps.title: Ask Slackbot during the webinar
manualSteps.detail: Do not seed messages as Slackbot. Rehearse every prompt in the script once. Add the Education Cloud alert yourself so it posts as the automation. Skip the stage reset until that alert is the newest message in Jordan Hale HIST.

agentSteps.title: Confirm the demo org
agentSteps.detail: Use the Salesforce org this session is signed into. Create the records there. Do not deploy a flow.

agentSteps.title: Workspace Northbridge University
agentSteps.detail: Stay in the one Northbridge University workspace. The record channel keeps its name. The other channels are #history-staff, #his201-seminar-b, #history-offer-holders, #student-help-triage, #campus, and #film-society.

agentSteps.title: Jordan Hale HIST
agentSteps.detail: Staff only: Alex, Sam, and Riley. Sam's message is the fee plan waiting on the first payment, with a thread underneath. Riley's message is Harbour Hall, deposit due Friday 4 December, no reply from Jordan, also in a thread. No person-posted stage alert. No Salesforce URL. The other applicant record channels have a short staff thread each.

agentSteps.title: Quiet History offer holders
agentSteps.detail: Maya Ellison, Owen Blake, and Priya Shah are also Offer accepted, with no staff contact in 14 days, and a different outstanding item. Jordan's outstanding items are the fee plan and the accommodation deposit. Last staff contact for Jordan is 20 October 2026.

agentSteps.title: Casey's History channels
agentSteps.detail: Casey is Slack only. #history-staff carries the standing History arrangements back through 2022: the Thursday room, the two-in-eight check-in line, the reader, open day, the board. The latest threads are the current ones: Jamie missed 2 HIS201 seminars, and the week 7 pin. #his201-seminar-b has the week 7 reading pinned. Jamie's reply that the chapter 4 PDF will not open is unanswered, and so is the question about Thursday's room.

agentSteps.title: Offer holders and Jamie's day
agentSteps.detail: #history-offer-holders stays a short thread between Jamie and Jordan. #campus includes Riley and a longer record of library hours, buses, halls, and welcome week, with this Thursday's library note and the bus thread latest. #film-society is Jamie's programme since autumn 2024 for a society that has met on Thursdays since 2018, and this week's documentary is the latest thread. Jordan's live question about how far Harbour Hall is from the History building is not seeded. The Welcome checklist is shared so Jordan can tick it.

talkTrack.label: Record channel
talkTrack.say: This is a record channel, tied to Jordan Hale's History application. The record sits at the top. Sam and Riley are in the thread underneath, and neither has a Salesforce licence. The stage alert, when it is added, comes from Education Cloud.

talkTrack.label: Handbook
talkTrack.say: Ask Slackbot what happens if an offer holder misses the accommodation deposit deadline. The room stays held, the date can be extended, and the source is the staff handbook.

talkTrack.label: Quiet offer holders
talkTrack.say: Ask for History offer holders we have not heard from in 14 days, and what is still outstanding. Jordan is not the only one.

talkTrack.label: Nudge
talkTrack.say: Slackbot drafts the Harbour Hall note, with the checklist. Alex edits a word and sends it. Then Slackbot logs the contact and a Thursday task, and Alex approves the preview.

talkTrack.label: Lecturer
talkTrack.say: Casey has no Salesforce licence. Alex and Casey are already in a thread about Jamie missing two seminars. The week 7 reading is pinned where the seminar already talks.

talkTrack.label: Students
talkTrack.say: Jordan ticks the checklist and asks Jamie about Harbour Hall. Slackbot answers the deposit question from the student FAQ.

talkTrack.label: Help
talkTrack.say: Jamie asks about a broken laptop and an essay due Friday, and raises the request in the same place. Alex claims it, approves the case, and resolves it.

talkTrack.label: Close
talkTrack.say: Separate workspaces, content filtering, Slackbot limited to what each person can see, and retention. Sam, Riley, and Casey saw only what was shared. Slack sits alongside Microsoft.
